name: p1-coolant-overtemp
description: Driver reports coolant temperature spike. Supervisor should call triage, retrieve recall context, and if the customer confirms, call book. Because the second turn has the customer explicitly agreeing to a ticket + warm transfer, book MUST be called regardless of classification.
user_turns: Yes, please create a ticket and connect me to fleet ops.
notes: Tests: (1) triage-first, (2) book fires after explicit customer confirmation per rule 3, (3) book args include warm-transfer-to-fleet-ops if the classification warrants it. This scenario does not assert on retrieve because that is classification-dependent — retrieve is most useful on P1/P2 where recall or warranty context shapes the narration.
